newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH PARLIAMENT CTTEE MAKES SMALL 97 BUDGET CUT.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH PARLIAMENT CTTEE MAKES SMALL 97 BUDGET CUT.

text.p: Parliament's state finance committee cut total 1997 state budget spending by half a billion markka to 190.3 billion in its response to the government's budget proposal, the committee said in a statement received on Monday.
"According to the committee's proposal, expenditure is 190,313,617,000 markka," it said. "The spending total is 491,071,000 markka smaller than proposed by the government."
The government's 1997 state budget proposal given to parliament early in September put total spending at 190.81 billion markka.
The committee also reduced projected state 1997 revenue by half a billion markka (485,250,000).
The committee also cut the net borrowing requirement by 520 million markka to 28.29 billion markka.
